quest.title: To a Carefree Vacation!
quest.description: As summer blooms once more, you and Paimon arrive in Tenochtzitoc and prepare yourselves for a carefree vacation...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Amilotl
dialogues.text: #Well, whaddya know? If it isn't our hero, the one and only {NICKNAME}, and {M#his}{F#her} trusty sidekick Paimon. Welcome to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, someone who knows us! But... Isn't this place supposed to be called Tenochtzitoc? You're saying it's actually a resort? How come we're only hearing about this now?

dialogues.speaker: Amilotl
dialogues.text: Haha, well, it hasn't always been. The resort's only just been built — in fact, technically, it's not even completely finished yet...

dialogues.speaker: Amilotl
dialogues.text: Anyway, here — take this invitation!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... So during the trial period, we can eat, drink, and enjoy ourselves as much as we want? Hehe, and look here, it even says: "All food, lodging, and entertainment expenses will be fully covered."

dialogues.speaker: Amilotl
dialogues.text: Exactly! Just kick back, relax, and enjoy your holiday at whatever pace suits you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Say no more! No one knows how to have a good time like Paimon, hehe...

dialogues.speaker: Amilotl
dialogues.text: Haha, then I won't keep you any longer. All that's left for me to say is — have a blast!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold up, doesn't that person over there look kinda familiar...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey, isn't that... Bennett!?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: ...Nice bandana!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wait, you mean... you like my bandana too? Hahaha, thanks a bunch!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bennett! And... Huh, a Monetoo that looks kinda... different.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}! Paimon! I'm not dreaming, am I? It's really you?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I feel like I got enough sleep last night, and... Yep, didn't forget to pack my bandages either...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #And I can remember things, like {NICKNAME} becoming a hero, and saving all of Natlan... So, nope! Definitely not dreaming!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that was one-hundred percent real life.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, and this little guy's a new friend I just made. He came running up to say hi the moment I got here... He's super friendly!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: And my luck's been so unreal lately! Look, I'm so unused to it that my fingers are shaking...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, your luck's finally turning around?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah! So many good things have happened to me recently, I can't even fit them all into my travel journal.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, what kind of stuff? Did you win some kind of lottery or something?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Nah, nothing like that! With my luck, you really think I'd bother signing myself up for a lottery? Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Here, I'll read you some of my recent entries... "Day One: Didn't fall into a puddle. Didn't miss the ferry."

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: "Day Five: At lunch, the Violetgold Angler Gulls didn't swoop in and steal my food. I even fed them some bread, and they were really friendly..."

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, and here's a good one! "Day Eleven: Got my hands on a sweet outfit from a shop in Natlan. Snagged a killer discount, and it's great quality too!"

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: "Day Twelve: Finally caught myself a real, live fish from a pond — and for once, not a boot or some other pile of junk!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... For Bennett, that actually does sound way luckier than usual!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It does, right? Once this trip's over, I'd better go thank that shopkeeper... The lucky color she picked for me actually worked!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lucky color? So, like... yellowy-orange?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Nope, lake blue!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I passed by a watersports shop that day, had a look around, but I didn't actually end up buying anything.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The shopkeeper was super friendly, though! She said she thought lake blue would suit me and suggested I give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...I think I know who you're talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Anyway, while my luck's holding out — is there anything I can help you guys with?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Any treasure maps you can't make out, clients you can't get in touch with, stuff like that? The way my luck's looking right now, I'm sure I'll be able to sort it out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no, no. No work talk! We're meant to be on vacation! Our top three priorities right now are fun, fun, and fun!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Sure, whatever you want. Seriously though, if you need anything, just let me know. Stuff like this never happens to me. So, I'd love to make the most of this lucky streak by helping out my friends!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Of course you can come! We're friends now too, after all! Let's go on an adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From Afar
dialogues.text: Look, there they are!

dialogues.speaker: Voice From Afar
dialogues.text: Hey there, friends, watch out! The ferry's coming in hot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that noise? Is it coming from the ocean?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: With the deep blue sea beneath you and my lucky Sharky Surfboard leading the way, are you ready to crank up the speed?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Take a deep breath, *inhale*... And... GO! C'mon, faster... faster!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let's share the fun and excitement with our friends on shore by giving them a nice big WAVE!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Yoo-hoo!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's Mualani!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It's the shopkeeper!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's... a massive wave!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: *sigh* If there's one thing that girl can do... It's making a "splash" wherever she goes.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ahhh... Nothing like the feeling of the sea breeze in your face!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Woohoo! Did you see that, everyone? A perfect landing, if I do say so myself!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: #Good thing {NICKNAME} managed to pull those two back in time, otherwise they would've gotten soaked!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ahaha, and? It's so sunny here, they'd dry off in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: And who might this be?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hello, my name's Bennett! I'm an adventurer from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aka the big boss of Benny's Adventure Team.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah, but as Adventurer Teams go, we're... not exactly the stuff of legends. I really admire you guys in Natlan. There are stories of legendary adventurers wherever you look...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The people here are so skilled, and you work in perfect sync with your saurian companions, helping solve problems wherever you go... It's inspiring!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: As for me... Ahem... Well, I might officially be the "leader," but... in reality, it's a team of one.

choices.text: Hey, I've worked for him in the past.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: #Hah, yeah right! Don't listen to {M#him}{F#her}, guys. {M#He's}{F#She's} just joking.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: If anything, it was the other way around. And even then, I was probably more of a hindrance than a help... Haha.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: #Nice outfit, by the way! I knew you'd look good in lake blue. I wish I'd known you were a friend of {NICKNAME}. I'd have given you a little souvenir from the shop!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Picking out a lucky color for me was the best gift I could have asked for! Oh, sorry, I still don't know your names!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I'm Mualani — when I'm not around running my shop, I'm out and about being a tour guide. And this here is Chasca, Peacemaker of the Flower-Feather Clan. Trust me, you do not wanna get on her bad side!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Uh... Sorry, but what would that look like? Getting on her bad side...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: You strike me as a pure-hearted adventurer — the humble, genuine type. You don't have to worry about that.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Wow, high praise right off the bat! Chasca's good at reading people. Do me next!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Look me in the eyes and tell me what I'm thinking!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: I've already told you, mind-reading isn't a required skill for a Peacemaker. Stop acting like I'm some kind of soul-seeing obsidian mirror.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: C'mon, just do it! Pretty please! You got it right the last two times.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: *sigh* Stop fantasizing about turning Soulsniper into a giant water gun. There's no way Xilonen will agree to that.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Right on the Mora!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, how did you know that, Chasca?

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: 'Cause on the surf over, she wouldn't stop shouting: "I really really want a water gun!" I've never wanted qucusaur wings more than that moment. Anything to block out the noise, honestly...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: C'mon, water guns are SO much fun! Besides, summer's not summer without a good water fight... or ten!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I know exactly what you mean! I have this one friend... Well, long story short, every time she heads down to the lake to go fish blasting, I get soaked from head to toe. It's so much fun!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Exactly! Playing with water's all about letting go of your worries and just having a blast!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You two sure speak the same language, alright...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: But this time, having fun in the water's not the only reason I'm here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Some serious business to take care of?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Yep! As a guide, if you want to create the best possible travel plan, you have to go out and experience everything for yourself! It's like being a guinea pig for your future clients!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Chasca's here to scope out the resort for her qucusaur family, too. After all, human or saurian, who doesn't love a good vacation?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Obviously, the resort is still in the trial phase, so there's bound to be some bumps in the road. But, we have tons of time on our hands, so we decided to officially sign ourselves up as testers!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Oh, Ifa and Ororon signed up, too. They got here earlier than us, though — said they were gonna go check up on the health of the saurian staff and aphids here at the resort.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: They should be just about wrapping things up by now, right? Maybe we'll run into them somewhere.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Well, seeing as we're all here for the same reason, why don't we stick together?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: After all, when it comes down to it, adventure's all about teamwork!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Sure! Sounds good to me.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Yeah, I'm down! The more, the merrier!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I heard there's this incredible, can't-miss experience called "Dreambow Drift" just over there in that canyon. Let's go check it out!

choices.text: We've been through thick and thin together.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: All thanks to me getting myself into danger. Heh, sorry about that... Anyway, I've been training hard lately, so I should be a lot stronger now!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Thanks for saying that, haha. Being your friend is one of the things I'm most proud of!

talks.objective: Head to the entrance of the canyon

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: Please embark from here! We'll set sail soon!

talks.objective: Ride the cruise ship and watch the show
Ride the cruise ship and watch the show

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, I don't think I've seen an Asha anywhere else in Natlan...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That's right, you won't find them outside of Tenochtzitoc.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: They're amazing artists, too! You should see their Chromalime graffiti...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It's really incredible. Sounds like something out of a fairy tale, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'm not sure my dads will even believe me if I tell them all this...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, that's not all. According to Granny Citlali, Tenochtzitoc's full of spiritual energy. I guess it follows that the Asha must be some kind of mysterious spiritual phenomenon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did she mention anything else about the Asha?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Nope. Granny's such a recluse, I doubt she's even seen one for herself!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: This one time, I knocked on her door, and when she answered, she had these huge dark circles and all she said was, "Evening." Except it was noon! The cloud-cover confused her, I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Well, sounds like she's got personality, that's for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, do you think he wants us to follow? Let's go take a look!

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: You're here early! Lots of visitors today?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Over there.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Oh, hello!

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Could I see your invitation, please? I'll get you all checked in to your accommodations.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. Is this what you mean? That's what Mr. Cyrus gave me.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Let me see... Ah, yes. This is one of the invitations that was sent out to adventurers all over Teyvat. One moment, please...

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Let's not trouble our guests, now, Asha...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh no, he's been no trouble at all! He's been super helpful! Led us right where we needed to go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, and he seems to have taken a special liking to Bennett! Won't even leave his side!

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Ah, I see what's going on here. Wanted to show off that new friend you made, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Aw, I appreciate that, little guy!

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Well, from the sound of it, he wants to stick by your side.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Seriously? That'd be great!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'll look after him! I promise!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like they've really clicked.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: What if it's the color? Maybe his lucky color is lake blue, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, or, hear Paimon out — maybe it's got something to do with spiritual energy?

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Well, if you don't mind, sir, then by all means... Spend as much time together as you like.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Congratulations! Benny's Adventure Team has a new member!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Guess we gotta look out for each other now, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Now then, before I give you a brief introduction to the resort, please take this map, along with a special commemorative photo album we prepared for all our guests.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: The resort is made up of four main areas: Colorfall Cliffs, Guiztli Ridge, Wavey Bay, and Tete Isle. Feel free to explore them at your leisure!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...Wavey Bay!

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: If you're interested in trying out our most popular attractions...

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: We highly recommend checking out the main challenge in each area. If you complete it, make sure to take a photo by the attraction and place it into the matching slot in your album.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Once you've collected all four photos, come back here to claim your final prize.

dialogues.speaker: Ukucha
dialogues.text: Of course, the album is yours to keep, so feel free to fill it up with all sorts of memories from your adventures!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wowwwww!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Whoa, Paimon's psyched out about this photo album.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Final... prize...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Earth to Paimon! Helloooo! Uh... On second thought, I don't think it's the album she's focused on...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh man, a prize? What could it be? I gotta know!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Uh-oh, we're losing another one...

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: Lastly, allow me to apologize in advance for a few things.

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: Due to ongoing construction, Tete Isle is temporarily closed. We kindly ask for your patience as we wrap that up and recommend saving it for last.

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: Also, we're still in the trial phase of operation, so you may encounter instances of understaffing in some areas...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Don't sweat it! We're a big group. We're more than happy to lend a hand.

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: That's great to hear.

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: Well, your accommodations are in that direction. Feel free to head there if you need some rest. And, if you're looking to do some shopping, the Easybreeze Market — our busiest attraction — is right over here.

response.speaker: Ukucha
response.text: Let me just double check... Yes, if you head over right now, you might just be in time to catch the Asha celebration parade.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Sounds great! Thanks for such a thorough rundown — not much even a guide like me could add!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oops, Paimon's supposed to be a guide, too, isn't she... Oh, hehe, sorry, she got distracted by the prize for a second...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Longest second I've ever seen.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's leave it to our two guides, then. Where to first?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: To the Easybreeze Market, and then straight to our rooms, of course! Who's ready to kick things off with a bonfire party?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Count me in!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a second! Bennett, weren't we on the same wavelength just now? Obviously, we should start with the challenges so we can nab the prize!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hey, there's no rush. It's not like the prize is suddenly gonna grow a pair of wings and fly off — and even if it did, we'd just chase it back down again.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Besides, our vacation's just getting started. Enjoying ourselves is way more important than chasing after the prize!

choices.text: Now, now. Who says we can't do both. Is it time for your snack?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Paimon does not appreciate being talked down to like a kid!

choices.text: Maybe focus on wrestling back that mascot title from the Asha instead...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Talk about rock bottom... Even the mascot role's been taken!

choices.text: She has a thing for collecting mementos from our travels.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A moment later, the table is covered in mouthwatering food.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way — *hic* — why'd you decide to visit Natlan, Bennett?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Was it the invitation from Cyrus?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Yeah, exactly!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: The Branch Master said that the Natlan Adventurers' Guild was inviting adventurers from all over to come check out the resort, and asked if I'd be willing to represent Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I've been waiting for a chance to go adventuring in a far-off land for ages now!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I just always used to worry about leaving my dads behind. And with my luck, I figured half the trip would be spent dealing with trouble along the way...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Well, things have been looking up for you lately, right? Just gotta find a way to make it last!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Haha, I'll do my best...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ah, I know! We should take you to visit Granny Citlali in the Masters of the Night-Wind. She can read your fortune, tell you what to watch out for, stuff like that... Seriously, she's scary accurate!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, she's the old granny you mentioned earlier, right? Hey, do you think she could tell us more about the Asha?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Old... isn't really the best word to describe this particular granny. You'll see once you meet her.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright, looks like everyone's just about finished eating, right? Time for our next activity — the "sun" offering ceremony... slash bonfire party!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Any volunteers to light the flame? Five, four, three, two, one... Great! Thank you all for so selflessly giving up such a precious opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She didn't even give anyone else a chance to chime in! Once Mualani's in party mode, she's like a kid on a sugar rush...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: As the sun sinks beneath the western shroud, let the sparks of flame guide us home.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: And a blazing light burn anew to cleanse impurities of old.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Uh, why's everyone so quiet?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, we can talk now?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Of course you can! Now that the blessing's done, the floor's open — go ahead and state your wishes.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: ...Ah, to the fire, not to me.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: May my family be safe, and may war be gone forever from Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Short, sweet, and full of impact!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: May all my friends, and all the people of Natlan, live the lives of their dreams...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: And above all, may Natlan's Ley Lines stay strong and steady...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, is it my turn? But... I'm not from Natlan. Will the Pyro Archon even know who's speaking?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just introduce yourself first!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hello, great Pyro Archon. Um, you don't know me, but my name is Bennett, and I'm an adventurer from Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I heard there was a terrible war in Natlan not too long ago, and that all the tribes suffered great pain and loss. I'm so sorry you and your people had to go through that.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'd like to offer a blessing for this wounded land, and for the people who worked so hard to save it.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I wish for timely rains, plentiful harvests, and for all people of this land to heal from the struggles of the past and embrace the dawn of a new day...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hmm, well said.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, and if you don't mind... there's also something a little more personal I'd like to add.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I miss my family back in Mondstadt. Sometimes while I'm off having fun with friends, I look up at the stars and wonder... Are they gazing at the same sky and feeling lonely instead?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: So, I'd like to wish all of my dads health and happiness.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: That's all.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Aww, hearing you say that, you've got me missing my mom and dad, too...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Their business abroad's been booming lately — when they're not out working all day, they're away on business trips for days on end. They're busier than I am most of the time, so I barely get to see them...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, um... Ahem, well, don't forget to bring them back plenty of souvenirs from the resort.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How've your dads been doing, Bennett?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh! They're doing great, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: When I asked them if I could go on this trip, they were all smiles.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: They told me to get out there and see the world, and then come back and tell them all about my adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Normally, if you asked the seven of them something completely mundane — like... what's the best flavor of sausage — you get eight different opinions.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I mean, the night before, two of them had actually gotten into an argument over a game of cards. But, in that moment, they were all in agreement.

choices.text: ...Do you think that was their plan all along?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yeah... Now that you mention it, that sounds about right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just goes to show how impressed they are with all your hard work. Your dads are rooting for you!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Just to double check, when you say "dads," are you referring to the people who take care of Bennett?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: More like Bennett takes care of them, nowadays...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Well, my dads are getting up there in age, so they don't have the energy for some stuff, y'know? I just lend them a hand when I can.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Sounds pretty impressive to me.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Ah, it's nothing. That's what family's for.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: So does that mean...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yep, I'm an orphan. I've been with the Adventurers' Guild for as long as I can remember. Haha, when you think about it, maybe I really was born to be an adventurer.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Even though my luck's always been terrible, my dads never gave up on me. With their help, I made it to where I am now, bumps along the road and all.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Growing up, I received so much kindness from people I didn't even know — and that's made me all the more determined to pay it forward, y'know?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Kinda like a relay race!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yeah, that's a good way to put it. Just like a relay race.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Hah, sounds like we've got a lot in common.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Y'know, relays are a team sport. So, by your own metaphor, you're not a solo adventurer at all!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Uh... Yeah, but don't forget, I'm super unlucky. In the past, bad luck has followed me wherever I've been... Most people wouldn't even dare team up with me.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Well, what kind of adventure doesn't have a few bumps in the road? Just ask me or Mualani — you can't fly without a little turbulence, or surf without making waves.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Heh, you really think so? Still, when it comes to me, it's usually more like tornados and tsunamis...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: That's not such a bad thing — sounds thrilling! Next time you go adventuring, I'm coming with! I've got mad surfing skills. You'll see!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Count me in too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oooh, does this mean that Benny's Adventure Team is expanding once again?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll take care of logistics.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Aren't you kind of overqualified for that...? Fine. Guess I'll be team cheerleader, then!

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: When fighting's off the table, I can always step in as an interpreter...?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Ha! I... can't tell you how grateful I am. I'm just... so lucky...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I've met the best bunch of people in the whole wide world. I'll treasure this friendship! I swear!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, something get in your eyes?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: It's the sparks... ahem, I mean, the smoke. S'just a little... strong.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Well, that just leaves the two of you. Anything you wanna say to the Pyro Archon?

choices.text: We're tight. No need for fancy speeches.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sure know how to slack off, huh? Fine, Paimon will speak for the both of us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: O great and mighty Pyro Archon... You've heard a bunch of wishes already, so Paimon will go with something different...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For herself, Paimon wishes for good food every day and sweet dreams every night.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But above all, may our friendship stay strong forever, so that no matter where life takes us, we'll always be able to share another unforgettable summer together.

choices.text: Said it with my heart already.
Maybe they're the ones who put your name forward.

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: Are you ready to board?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, so this is the dining area! Gimme a sec, I'll go find a staff member! See what they recommend!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Need a hand with that?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: No need. You all sit tight. I'll be right back.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Are you sure? I can—

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: That's Mualani for you, extrovert to the core, always making friends and taking care of people.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Stick her in a corner by herself and tell her not to talk, and she wouldn't know what to do with herself.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh, really? You must've been friends for ages to know her so well!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Yeah, it's been a while. She talks, I listen, sometimes we spar — that's our friendship in a nutshell.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: How about you, Bennett — this your first time in Natlan? Anyone make the trip with you?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh yeah! Funny you ask, I do have a travel buddy. His name's Venti, and he's the best bard in all of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tone-Deaf Bard! It's been ages since we last saw him. Why haven't we seen him yet?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: He said he was planning on visiting a friend somewhere else in Natlan first, so he'll be a few days late. He told me to just go ahead and have fun in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A friend in Natlan? Huh. Who could that be?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Sorry, I didn't think to ask... But considering how amazing he is, I wouldn't be surprised if he knew just about anyone!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Okay everyone, hope you're feeling hungry! Come grab a seat, I picked out all the best dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Miztli
dialogues.text: Take your time! Just let me know when you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beep-beep, keywords detected! "All food, lodging, and entertainment expenses will be fully covered during the trial period."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Does that mean... We get to go back to full-on vacation mode again!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are we waiting for? Next stop, Tenochtzitoc!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Back in Mondstadt, our transport balloons always have an Anemo Slime inside them... or at least something that looks just like one.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I used to love picking up this one commission from Katheryne called "Safe Conduct."

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: All the monsters would just rush straight for me, totally ignoring the balloon! Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You meet up with your companions by the shore...
